why: The new fallback that prioritizes keeping numerals adjacent to their units made the model avoid punctuation/clause-boundary cuts and instead pick earlier internal cuts; that fixed many short/numeric splits (positive mean change in the ≤3/≤5/≤7 bins) but degraded performance on longer pieces where demoting punctuation boundaries produced awkward internal splits (negative mean change in the ≤10 and ≤99 bins and nearly equal n_worse/n_better).
lesson: Later revisions should protect numeral+unit adjacency but not demote punctuation/clause-boundary cuts across the board — keep punctuation boundaries as the fallback for longer segments or when no numeral/unit candidate is present.
blamed: C9 «- As a last resort, prefer a cut at a punctuation or clause »
